title: TerminalReaderReaderResourceCart
description: Represents a cart to be displayed on the reader

currency.description: Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

line_items.description: List of line items in the cart.

tax.description: Tax amount for the entire cart. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).

total.description: Total amount for the entire cart, including tax. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
